# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> > Comprehensive English language learning resource from Oxford University Press, featuring the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary, Oxford Advanced American Dictionary, and Practical English Usage with corpus-based definitions, pronunciation guides, and vocabulary tools.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries provides authoritative dictionary entries with detailed pronunciation, usage notes, collocations, and examples drawn from the British National Corpus and Oxford Corpus Collection. The platform includes specialized resources like the Oxford 3000 essential word list and Michael Swan's Practical English Usage grammar reference for English learners worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary
- Oxford 3000 essential vocabulary
- Pronunciation guides (British and American English)
- English vocabulary and word meanings
- Practical English Usage
- Oxford Collocations Dictionary
- Dictionary definitions and usage notes
- British National Corpus
- Oxford Corpus Collection
- Grammar reference for learners
- American English pronunciation
- Formal and informal language usage
- Oxford University Press
- Michael Swan (grammar author)
- IPA phonetic transcription

## Essential Learning Resources

- [About the Oxford 3000 word list at Oxford Learner's Dictionaries](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/oxford3000.html): Guide to Oxford 3000: essential English vocabulary based on corpus research
- [Pronunciation guide for American Dictionary at OxfordLearnersDictionaries.com](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/american_english/pronunciation_american_english.html): American English pronunciation guide with IPA symbols and phonetics
- [The story behind Practical English Usage](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/practical-english-usage/what-teachers-say.html): Testimonials and story behind Michael Swan's Practical English Usage

## Common Vocabulary Entries

- [about adjective - Definition, pictures, pronunciation and usage notes](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/about_3): Dictionary entry for 'about' adjective with idioms and grammar notes
- [aboard adverb - Definition, pictures, pronunciation and usage notes](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/aboard): Dictionary entry for 'aboard' adverb with transportation vocabulary
- [accident-prone adjective - Definition, pictures, pronunciation and usage notes](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accident-prone): Dictionary entry for 'accident-prone' with pronunciation and examples
- [accredited adjective - Definition, pictures, pronunciation and usage notes](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accredited): Dictionary entry for 'accredited' with usage notes and examples
- [acid noun - Definition, pictures, pronunciation and usage notes](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acid_1): Dictionary entry for 'acid' noun with chemistry definitions and usage

## Formal and Specialized Vocabulary
